original: sav[y]e rūpavajrādharmadhātuvajrāyamārīnāṃ | dakṣiṇasya vāme ratnasaṃbhavamāmakyoḥ | savye śabdavajrāprajñāntakayoḥ | paścimasya vāme 'mitābhapāṇḍarayoḥ | savye gandhavajrāpadmāntakayoḥ | uttarasya vāme 'moghasiddhitārayoḥ | savye rasavajrāsparśavajrāvighnārīṇāṃ | yamāryādikrodhānāṃ agnyādikoṇeṣv iti kaścit |
analyzed: savye rūpa vajra adharmadhātu vajra ayamārīnām dakṣiṇasya vāme ratnasaṃbhava māmakyoḥ savye śabda vajra aprajñā antakayoḥ paścimasya vāme mita ābha pāṇḍarayoḥ savye gandha vajra padma antakayoḥ uttarasya vāme mogha siddhi tārayoḥ savye rasa vajra asparśa vajra avighna arīṇām yamāri ādi krodhānām agni ādi koṇeṣu iti kaścid

original: % de'i rjes su sngar lhag par gnas pa byas pa'i bum pa rnams g-yas skor du dgod par bya'o || de la 'khor lo'i dbang po'i rnam par rgyal ba'i bum pa ni dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i g-yas phyogs nas bskor te rdo rjer ba'i bdag nyid kyi khor yug dang 'bar ba'i phreng {112b7} ba'i sa gzhi'i phyi rol du dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo'i thad ka'i gnas las cung
analyzed: dei rjes su sngar lhag par gnas pa byas pai bum pa rnams gyas skor du dgod par byao de la khor loi dbang poi rnam par byao de la khor loi dbang poi rnam par byao de ni dkyil khor gyi khor loi gyas phyogs nas bskor te rdo rjes bai bdag nyid kyi khor yug dang bar bai phreng 112b7 bai sa gzhii phyi rol du dkyil khor gyi shar sgoi thad kai gnas las cung

original: zad g-yas su gzhag par bya'o || g-yon logs su ni go rims ji lta ba bzhin du g-yas skor gyis rnam par snang mdzad dang spyan ma dang las thams cad pa'i bum pa ste g-yas su gzugs rdo rje dang chos {113a1} || dbyings rdo rje ma dang gshin rje mthar byed rnams kyi'o ||
analyzed: R gyas su gzhag par byao gyon logs su ni go rims ji lta ba bzhin du gyas skor gyis rnam par snang mdzad dang spyan ma dang las thams cad pai bum pa ste gyas su gzugs rdo rje dang chos dbyings rdo rje ma dang gshin rje mthar byed rnams kyio

original: lho'i g-yon du rin chen 'byung ldan dang m'a ma k'i dang g-yas su sgra rdo rje ma dang shes rab mthar byed dag gi'o || nub kyi g-yon du snang ba mtha' yas dang gos dkar mo dag dang g-yas su dri rdo rje ma dang | padma mthar byed dag {113a2} gi'o || byang gi g-yon du don yod grub pa dang | sgrol ma dag dang | g-yas su rdo rje ma dang |
analyzed: R gyon du rin chen byung dang ma ma ki dang gyas su sgra rdo rje ma dang shes rab mthar byed dag gio nub kyi gyon du snang ba mtha yas dang gos dkar mo dag dang gyas su dri rdo rje ma dang padma mthar byed dag gio byang gi gyon du don yod grub pa dang sgrol ma dag dang gyas su rdo rje ma dang sgrol ma dang dang gyas su rdo rje ma dang

original: reg bya rdo rje ma dang | bgegs mthar byed dag gi'o || gshin rje mthar byed la sogs pa khro bo rnams kyi ni me la sogs pa'i mtshams rnams su'o zhes pa kha cig gis te {113a3} de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi de ma thag tu khro bo rnams kyi dang rigs kyi yum rnams kyi ni sgo'i g-yas rnams su'o zhes pa gzhan dag gis so ||
analyzed: reg bya rdo rje ma dang bgegs mthar byed dag gio gshin rje mthar byed la sogs pa khro bo rnams kyi ni me la sogs pai mtshams rnams suo zhes pa kha cig gis te de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi de ma thag tu khro bo rnams kyi dang rigs kyi yum rnams kyi ni sgoi gyas rnams suo zhes pa gzhan dag gis so

original: 'di'i rjes su 'brangs nas phyogs gzhan rnams su yang dgod par shes par bya'o || 'dod pa gzhan yang yod mod des ci zhig {113a4} bya | de ltar 'di ni 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor la bum pa dgod pa'o ||
analyzed: dii rjes su brangs nas phyogs gzhan rnams su yang dgod par shes par byao dod par gzhan yang yod mod des ci zhig ci ni jam pai rdos rjei dkyil khor la bum pa dgod pao

original: piṇḍīkramamaṇḍale vāme kulamātranantaraṃ savye ca prathamam aṣṭabodhisattvānāṃ koṇakrodhānāṃ koṇeṣu yamāryanantaram uṣṇīṣacakriṇaḥ | padmāntakānantaraṃ sumbhasyeti viśeṣaḥ || etadanusārāt maṇḍalāntareṣu ghaṭanyāsaḥ sugama iti neha prapañcitaḥ ||
